name: Wet Blanket
disable: DC 40 Diplomacy check or DC 40 Intimidation check (expert) twice to convince Wet Blanket to stay silent, DC 42 Occultism check or DC 42 Religion check (master) to exorcise Wet Blanket's spirit, or DC 38 Performance check (expert) twice to drown out Wet Blanket's music. A PC holding Wet Blanket's fiddle of the maestro gains a +2 item bonus to any check made to disable the haunt.
reset: Unless the haunt is disabled, Wet Blanket falls silent once all creatures leave the room. She returns if another creature moves adjacent to the gate.
routine:
(1 action; auditory, concentrate, emotion, incapacitation, mental) Wet Blanket's tune causes creatures who hear it to act irrationally. Each creature in the area attempts a DC 40 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes immune to the tune for 1 minute.
Success The creature is Stunned 1.
Failure The creature is Confused for 1 minute. They can attempt a new save at the end of each of their turns to end the confusion.
Critical Failure As failure, and the creature immediately attacks themself. The Strike doesn't give the creature a flat check to recover from the confusion.

items.name: Crescendo
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the iron gate

---
Effect Wet Blanket's discordant tune swells to a crescendo. Each creature in the area must succeed at a DC 42 Will save saving throw or be Stupefied 1 for 1 minute (or Stupefied 2 on a critical failure). The hazard then rolls initiative.

text: Wet Blanket's invisible spirit plays a discordant tune that confounds the senses.
